title: Chapter 415
paragraphs: Chapter 415
Episode 120. Why is it Highran? (9)
Most people on the ground couldn't immediately recognize what the iron gate forming in the sky was.
However, they could intuit that whatever was coming out of the gate would not be an ally.
"What's that...?"
"A person?"
"It's too blurry to see clearly."
While the warriors exchanged glances and conversations, Lon, Linpa, and Beract stopped fighting momentarily and looked up at the sky.
Then, the leader emerged from the iron gate.
His distinct pale body and the shimmering radiance that enveloped him.
Surprisingly, the leader was floating in the sky. Without wings or any device, he hovered in front of Grunil for a few seconds, staring down at the ground as if he were a god.
The atmosphere on the battlefield was as if a god had truly descended. Giant monsters, magicians, living golems, flying ships, and now this mysterious, pale, and shimmering figure.
Most of the warriors on the battlefield felt a strange fear and alienation towards Kinzelro's leader. A foreboding feeling that the tide of battle could turn once again clouded the warriors' minds.
And Jin was deeply displeased that the warriors felt such emotions when they saw the leader.
A divine being, or an unfamiliar fear.
In Jin's opinion, such grand images did not suit Kinzelro's leader.
"A despicable criminal."
Nothing more, nothing less.
Even a descriptor like 'stupid' should be added.
'If you wanted to give me a huge advantage, you shouldn't have approached like this.'
Whoosh...!
A spark shot up from Jin's palm.
It was a weak spark. However, the tiny shadow of the spark that was pinned like a dot on his palm would soon become a sky-covering spiritual energy.
Myol Salamcheonyeomok, the final form of the Flame Demon Emperor
The shadow of the spark soared into the sky.
Murakan's spiritual energy curtain, which filled the sky, was torn and had holes in it. However, as the legacy of the Flame Demon Emperor manifested, it quickly mended.
As a result, Jin, who had opened his spiritual energy, began to connect with the sky.
Until now, the sudden darkness in the sky, like the atrocities Kinzelro had committed at Gyeomhwang Castle, was an utterly unfamiliar sight to the warriors.
However, unlike the leader's appearance, the warriors could accurately recognize whose power this was and what it was.
Spiritual energy.
The power of the 12th generation Runecandel, the contractor of Soldelet.
Perhaps that's why, even if it didn't fit the situation, the warriors were secretly looking forward to what kind of change Jin would show them.
"Murakan."
[Yes.]
"Fill in the lack of spiritual energy."
Although he had somewhat recovered, he was not yet perfect.
Understood.
However, with Murakan present, there was no shortage in displaying the legacy of Liol Gipple.
Flutter, whooosh-!
As Murakan spread its wings and released its aura, black particles surged like waves in the area. The particles wrapped around Jin and Murakan and soared into the sky.
It was as if a door was opening.
The particles of aura extending to the sky were drawing a line. A line that split the sky in half.
Soon, an enormous void opened in the middle of the sky, and Liol Gipple's shining rune characters were vividly visible on Jin's body.
The rune characters flickered like snowflakes as they gently floated in the air.
-[Ah! Damn it!]
Why, Commander?
-[I left it behind. Damn it, the situation was so urgent that I didn't think to take it. Ha, such a mistake...!]
-What is it? Oh, don't tell me...!

-[The ultimate form of Myeolsal-Amcheon-Hwayeomok. I didn't take the legacy of Liol Gipple that was stored in the Dark Magic Association's headquarters. Jo, did you happen to take it? I hope you say yes.]
-Heh. Well, Commander, I also didn't have the opportunity...
-You useless, idiotic child! Jo, are you telling me that you, the leader of the Dark Magic Association, forgot about it? Should the commander be concerned about such things!
At that moment, the members of Kinjello couldn't help but recall the conversation at that time.
The great magic that Jin was unfolding was obtained after annihilating the Dark Magic Association.
The legacy of Liol that Commander and Jo failed to secure was now going to be a disaster that would engulf the ship Grunnel and the Kinjello members.
The rune characters fluttering in the air were a sign. As the signs pointed to Grunnel and Kinjello's members, a crimson sphere revealed itself from the opened sky.
People momentarily thought it was the sun. If not, they couldn't accept the enormous fireball that was emitting a heavy and dense heat to the ground.
"This is, dam-, dam-, damn it! This is Liol Gipple's...!"
"Jo! Deploy the barrier!"
"Grunnel hasn't been repaired yet... Cough!"
"Ugh! Aaargh!"
Sizzle-! Whoosh!
A shower of flames poured from the fireball. Instead of striking the ground, the shower took the shape of converging on the ship and the commander.

Already thousands, tens of thousands of tendrils of fire were entwining the ship Grunnel. Grunnel was immobilized like an animal caught in a trap, and the commander's unique pale form was completely hidden by the fire.
Under the black and crimson sky, the sounds of the destruction of the ship Grunnel spread with the fire.
Crack, crunch...! Every time the whip of fire struck, the hull was shattered, and the fragments turned to ash before even reaching the ground, scattering in the wind.
"Urazil...!"
Berakth clenched his teeth and swung his greatsword.

With the leader engulfed in flames as soon as he appeared, the useless Jo not knowing how to deal with the situation, and the deputy leader injured and barely rescued, Berakth was the only one left to target Jin.
'I must get rid of that damned magic. If I don't, the leader's life could be in danger!'
Foaming at the mouth, Berakth madly swung his greatsword. However, his opponents were Ron and Linfa. The two easily blocked Berakth's attacks.
"You're quite desperate, it seems your master is in danger."
Ron accurately read his thoughts, and Berakth responded with a roar. However, his roar was no longer able to instill fear in the battlefield as it once did.
If Ron and Linfa hadn't weakened the Grunil ship beforehand, they wouldn't have been able to gain the upper hand so quickly after the great magic was cast.
The once majestic ship was nowhere to be seen, and the burning Grunil seemed to be on the verge of being shot down.
On the other hand, the flames spreading from the Annihilation Black Heaven Fire Pearl Great Emperor Final Form grew increasingly fierce.
The ground forces, of course, assumed the situation had turned in their favor.
However, Jin, Murakan, and some exceptional warriors felt a strange sense of unease.
'It's only a matter of time before the Grunil ship is destroyed, but the leader... he's not finished yet.'
The leader was an enigmatic figure shrouded in mystery. As a result, not only Jin and his comrades but also other forces had no clear understanding of the extent of his abilities.
However, since he led a huge force called 'Kinzello' and wielded such extraordinary power, they believed it wouldn't end like this.
Creak, crack...! Boom-!
Eventually, the Grunil ship began to crash.
It was split in half, and various parts were destroyed beyond recognition. No one could easily imagine the Grunil ship returning to its original form.
The moment the massive hull struck the ground, it seemed the Bisuchel party on board would meet their doom.
However, even as the ship crashed, Jin felt an eerie chill down his spine. It was like a cold iron block passing by...
At that moment, Jin turned his body.
Iron, steel.
The chill he felt on his spine was not just a sensation born from a sense of unease.
It was a sensation that began with a real object. Out of nowhere, black iron blocks, the origin of which was unknown, brushed past Jin and Murakan and soared into the sky.
Not only did the iron blocks affect the two, but they also overturned the entire battlefield. A whirlwind of iron blocks began to devour the battlefield.
[It's his power, kid.]
"…Yeah, it seems so."
The leader of Kinzelo possessed the power to manipulate iron like a blacksmith deity.
And when the new blacksmith deity, Picon Minche, wielded the power of iron, he had sensed it too. It was said that the leader's power was even greater than Picon's.
Runes were drawn on the floating iron chunks in the air. Following the markings, chains of fire swept in and melted them, but they couldn't eliminate them all.
An enormous amount of iron filled the sky, enough to overwhelm Jin's flames.
'Fortunately, the iron chunks themselves don't seem to have any particularly dangerous energy. From the start... is it not meant for killing?'
The iron chunks did not strike down enemies like Jin's fire.
Instead, they enveloped the falling battleship Grunil. A huge hand made of iron had formed and was now supporting Grunil.
[As expected, the welcoming ceremony is grand. The legacy of Leol Zipl... It's because of that I've suffered a lot in the meantime. Somehow, that archmage doesn't seem to get along with me.]
As the flames receded, the leader's figure was revealed once again.
Unlike the first time when he was just a faint, glowing figure, his body now formed a structure that could be called a 'skeleton.'
'Did he use the power of steel to create bones...?'

-Now, seeing how you judged Murakan's memory as you pleased earlier, it seems like cheap psychological counseling time. This time, let me guess your psychology. You came here to save those three, and you triggered some kind of trap. But now your insides are a little burnt. That's because it doesn't seem like we'll fall for the trap.
-[Hahaha...']
-What are you laughing at, you scum? Was I wrong? Where do you think you're going? Answer me.
-[You got me. You're right, Jin Runkandel. You've almost pinpointed everything accurately. I'm currently in no condition to properly deal with you guys. As you can see, I don't even have bones.]
The conversation they had the first day they met the leader.
The leader, who formed 'steel bones,' was radiating an energy incomparable to that time.
Although his face was blurry and hard to see, Jin was certain. The leader was smiling.
[Long time no see, Jin Runkandel. How have you been?]
“It's not like we're close enough to ask about each other's well-being...”
Jin paused and shifted his gaze to the area behind the leader.
There, the seemingly destroyed battleship Grunil emerged unscathed from the grip of the giant steel hand.
It was just as it had been at the beginning. Not a single scratch had been restored to its original state.
“…Isn't it not?”
As Jin continued his sentence, the leader shook his head.
[That's a pity if you think so. I actually missed you quite a bit. I also have to reclaim the stolen legacy of the archmage.]
